profile.headline: Builder
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience building products and experiences for consumers. I'm primarily a backend engineer with experience working with large distributed systems, cloud, device software, and ml/ai xfn partners.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led a cross-functional team in conceptualizing and architecting a Configurations Service, empowering stakeholders to effortlessly modify business logic and configurations through an intuitive UI. 
- Analyzed engineering weeks incurred by the current approach vs projected future savings and convinced leadership and xfn teams of the project's positive ROI.
- Utilized a Java backend with EC2, DynamoDB, gRPC, and React front end.
- Maintained consistent communication with stakeholders during development and pilot with weekly syncs and updates.


Collaborated with SMEs to model real-world air freight complexities and operator workflows in to simple UI tasks.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Software Infrastructure · Software Design · Project Planning · Team Management · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React.js · Coaching & Mentoring · Ruby on Rails · GraphQL · Git · SQL · Kubernetes · Apache Kafka · docker

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Product focused senior software engineer building home and work experiences leveraging ai and ml technologies.

- Worked on the Meta Portal Smart Camera tracking system within the Android Java app layer. 
- Developed and maintained Android based Smart Camera APIs that integrated with first and third party calling software. 
- Created algorithms that used software to crop camera frames based on ML models to track and frame participants. 
- Led user research and feedback acquisition as well as feature development with calling app and camera hardware teams.
- Built a C++ library that housed the camera algorithms and extended the software to work on Macbooks and Cisco meeting devices.
- Led algorithm development of Conference Room Brady Bunching software that would individually frame participants in large meeting rooms.
- Accounted for complex use cases such as overlapping frames, speaker preference, and dynamic aspect ratios. 
- Developed the library in C++ which allowed us to extend the framing software into third party devices. 
- Integrated this software into 1st party cloud infrastructure, which allowed us to integrate this service with messenger and workplace calling.
positions.insights: Skills: Android · Ai · Distributed Systems · C++ · Java · Python · Kotlin · Git
